blind.description: A heavy iron bar cell door leaf featuring a thick rectangular outer frame, six vertical cylindrical bars, two horizontal reinforcing straps with visible round rivets, two side hinges, and an attached rectangular lockbox with a keyhole. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous with stylized dark weathered metal textures and subtle edge wear and rust accents.
blind.from_above: A narrow horizontal rectangular metal bar with small hinge protrusions on the left side and a lockbox protrusion on the right side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 feet tall (reaches the upper chest/shoulder of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide.
